title: Sold Out in Fifteen Minutes  (十五分钟售罄)

segments.t: 在熙熙攘攘的咖啡馆柜台前，泰莎以最快的速度把金黄色的酸塔切开放进白盘子，汉娜和欧文则端着托盘飞奔向外面的餐桌。先听听整个场景。
Two mint teas and three lemon tarts for table four under the tree!
Coming right up! Owen, take the hot teapot to the corner window table!
Table two says this almond crust is the best pastry on Linden Street!
Tell table two the secret was my two kitchen apprentices on Wednesday!
How many slices of lemon tart are left on tray four, Tessa?
Count them: one, two, three, out of forty slices in fifteen minutes!
Good thing you baked two extra trays of warm cinnamon rolls just in case!
Listen, the room just went quiet! Someone is tapping a music stand!
Our neighbor from number ten brought his violin case inside Room Nine!
Leave the clean plates for five minutes, both of you. Come listen at the door!
Save those last three slices of tart for Evelyn, Graham, and Arthur!
Aprons off: it is six o'clock on Friday!
现在，让我们仔细听听这些生动的对话。
Two mint teas and three lemon tarts for table four under the tree!
「树下的四号桌，两杯薄荷茶，三份柠檬塔！」 在咖啡馆点单时，原本不可数的饮料可以加上复数形式
Two mint teas
这是一种实用的说法，意思是“两杯薄荷茶”。
Coming right up! Owen, take the hot teapot to the corner window table!
「马上就好！欧文，把这壶热茶端到角落窗户那桌！」 这是北美咖啡馆里非常经典的回复
Coming right up
告诉客人他们的点单这一秒钟就在柜台上准备好了。
Table two says this almond crust is the best pastry on Linden Street!
「二号桌说这杏仁酥皮是菩提树街上最棒的糕点！」 在餐桌服务中，提到客人时通常直接用位置来称呼
Table two says
而烘焙面团的底部酥皮叫作
almond crust
杏仁酥皮或杏仁底。
Tell table two the secret was my two kitchen apprentices on Wednesday!
「告诉二号桌，秘诀是我星期三的两位厨房学徒！」 泰莎充满爱意地提到了她的帮手：复数形式的
apprentices
指的是学徒或者帮手。
How many slices of lemon tart are left on tray four, Tessa?
「四号烤盘里还剩下几块柠檬塔，泰莎？」 如果要问还剩下多少个，可以这样用
are left
字面意思是“被留在”托盘上。
Count them: one, two, three, out of forty slices in fifteen minutes!
「数数看：一、二、三，四十块柠檬塔十五分钟内就只剩这些了！」 在最初的总数前面，用来表示“四十个当中的比例”用了
out of forty slices
指四十块总量中剩下的最后三块。
Good thing you baked two extra trays of warm cinnamon rolls just in case!
「幸好你多烤了两盘热肉桂卷，以防万一！」 放在句子最后非常实用，这个具有预防意味的短语
just in case
短短三个词就浓缩了“以防万一，作为防备”的意思。
Listen, the room just went quiet! Someone is tapping a music stand!
「听，外面突然安静了！有人在敲谱架！」 动词 go 用在
just went quiet
中，表示气氛突然变得安静，接着提到
music stand
用来支撑乐谱的谱架。
Our neighbor from number ten brought his violin case inside Room Nine!
「我们十号房的邻居把他的小提琴琴盒带进九号房了！」 对于娇贵的乐器来说，硬质的琴盒叫作
violin case
小提琴琴盒。
Leave the clean plates for five minutes, both of you. Come listen at the door!
「干净盘子先放五分钟，你们俩。快来门边听！」 想同时亲切地招呼两个人，这个表达
both of you
意思是“你们俩”。
Save those last three slices of tart for Evelyn, Graham, and Arthur!
「把最后三块酸塔留给伊芙琳、格雷厄姆和阿瑟！」 除了拯救或节省，在厨房里动词
Save
也可以表示“为某人保留或留出某物”。
Aprons off: it is six o'clock on Friday!
「解下围裙：星期五的六点钟到了！」 甚至不需要动词，这个简短的指令
Aprons off
就足以宣布音乐休息时间的开始。再一次完整聆听这个场景吧。
Two mint teas and three lemon tarts for table four under the tree!
Coming right up! Owen, take the hot teapot to the corner window table!
Table two says this almond crust is the best pastry on Linden Street!
Tell table two the secret was my two kitchen apprentices on Wednesday!
How many slices of lemon tart are left on tray four, Tessa?
Count them: one, two, three, out of forty slices in fifteen minutes!
Good thing you baked two extra trays of warm cinnamon rolls just in case!
Listen, the room just went quiet! Someone is tapping a music stand!
Our neighbor from number ten brought his violin case inside Room Nine!
Leave the clean plates for five minutes, both of you. Come listen at the door!
Save those last three slices of tart for Evelyn, Graham, and Arthur!
Aprons off: it is six o'clock on Friday!
三十七块柠檬塔在十五分钟内一扫而空，六点钟一到，整个庭院安静了下来。下个场景九号房间见。
See you soon!
